source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted onEndMsgDownload compares its URL with browser.currentURI before doing message-specific work and checks again after an awaited document load. The message pane can navigate away during the wait. For this post-load path, preserve that URL guard when adding asynchronous work so a previous message does not update the new one. This is a limited current refinement of the historical 1297 path, not a full study of the later fix or a general navigation guarantee. No rapid-selection or delayed-load test was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Current message post-load work checks that the original URL is still displayed
